beats.say: There's a country completely trapped inside another country.
beats.title: A COUNTRY INSIDE A COUNTRY

beats.say: This is Lesotho. Every single border it has is with South Africa.
Only three countries on Earth are fully surrounded like this: Lesotho, San Marino and Vatican City. And Lesotho is by far the biggest.
It's also called the Kingdom in the Sky. Its lowest point is about fourteen hundred meters above sea level.
That's the highest lowest point of any country in the world. Snow falls here in winter, in Africa.
Lesotho sells water to South Africa through huge tunnels, from dams in its mountains to Johannesburg.
A kingdom in the sky, surrounded on every side. Follow for more.
beats.title: SURROUNDED ON EVERY SIDE
